listing.name: Way of the Samurai — way-of-the-samurai-decomp (dnb4ever)
listing.summary: Matching C and a separate static native runtime reach their own IOP, main loop and first frames. Full gameplay has not been established. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA NTSC-U SLUS20407 disc and ELF.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Generate code and build locally from source. The number of matching functions does not establish how much native gameplay works.

warnings: Matching C and a separate static native runtime reach their own IOP, main loop and first frames. Full gameplay has not been established.
